sections.title: Skins
items: The Skin Changer now uses minecraftskins.com (The Skindex) as its only catalogue. The built-in placeholder skins are gone.
Browse Top, Latest and Recently commented, search the whole site, and keep loading pages to reach the full library.
Every card shows the real preview, creator and likes. Selecting a skin fetches its exact 64×64 texture, detects Classic or Slim, and caches it locally.
Apply any Skindex skin to your Microsoft account, open its original page, or upload your own 64×64 PNG.

sections.title: Also in this build
items: Everything from 1.0.6: custom server addresses, importing existing servers, world and island presets, 50+ settings, 27 gamerules, command help, item giving, backups and the expanded Hosting tabs.

sections.title: Notes
items: The skin library streams from minecraftskins.com, so it needs an internet connection. Previewed skins stay cached on this PC, and the site may occasionally rate-limit requests.

sections.title: Hosting
items: Choose your own server address: a domain with a real ending like .net, .com, .org or .gg, or an IPv4 or localhost address. Triad validates it and lets you copy it from the Hosting header.

Import a Minecraft server you already have: pick its folder, and Triad detects the version and jar, copies the world, settings, ops and whitelist into the launcher, and leaves the original folder untouched.
Six world presets, including starter island and sky island, with grass, desert, snow or Nether island themes and an optional seed.
More than 50 server settings, from MOTD, difficulty and whitelist to view distance, the Nether, structures, RCON, query and resource packs.
27 world rules with plain-English explanations, plus a reset-to-defaults button. Saved rules reapply when the server starts.
A searchable library of 85 commands with descriptions, a saved-command list and a give-item builder for 30 items.
Create and open world backups, set automatic saves, and configure network and performance options from the new Tools tab.

sections.title: Skins
items: The Skin Changer now streams the minecraftskins.com (The Skindex) catalogue live instead of showing built-in placeholder skins.
Browse Top, Latest and Recently commented, search the whole site, and keep loading pages to reach the full catalogue.
Every card shows the real skin preview, its creator and likes. Selecting one fetches the exact texture, detects Classic or Slim, and caches it locally.
Apply any Skindex skin to your Microsoft account, open its original page, or keep uploading your own 64×64 PNG.

sections.title: Fixes and safeguards
items: Clearing gamerules now removes the saved rules instead of merging them back in.
Saving an imported server keeps its original world generator unless you choose a new preset.
The Open backups folder action now creates the folder safely instead of copying the server into itself.

sections.title: Notes
items: Servers run on this PC while Triad is open, and stop when the launcher closes.
A custom address still needs DNS and port forwarding before players outside your network can use it. Players on this PC can always join localhost on the server port.
The skin library needs an internet connection. Skins you have previewed are cached on this PC, and the site may occasionally rate-limit requests.

sections.title: Hosting
items: New Hosting tab: create a Vanilla or Fabric Minecraft server for any release version, right inside Triad.
Triad downloads the official server jar, creates the world and starts the server for you.
A live console with command input, player count and clear start, stop and error states.
Configure the MOTD, port, memory, difficulty, gamemode, max players, view and simulation distance, spawn protection, PvP, online mode, whitelist, flight, command blocks and hardcore mode.
Save your own commands as one-click buttons and run them from the Commands tab.
Open the server folder to add datapacks, worlds or backups.

sections.title: Settings
items: Settings now shows the installed Triad version and a Check for updates button, so you can check without waiting for the automatic check.

sections.title: Notes
items: Servers run on this PC while Triad is open, and stop when the launcher closes.
Players on the same network can join with this PC's local IP and the server port; players outside it need port forwarding.

sections.title: Potato graphics
items: Added a Potato intensity slider, from a light trim to full potato, so you choose how much the preset dials back.
The preset now writes Minecraft 1.21.11's quality settings too: graphics preset, see-through leaves, texture filtering, cloud distance, weather radius and chunk fade.
Full potato drops to 4 chunks, no mipmaps and 0.5x entity distance, and no longer caps FPS at 120.
Settings are written to every instance as soon as you change them, and again before every launch.

releases.title: Potato graphics and a wider performance kit

sections.title: Potato graphics
items: New Settings toggle for low-end PCs and maximum FPS.
Lowers render distance to 6 chunks, uses fast graphics, minimal particles, no clouds or shadows, and turns off smooth lighting and VSync before every launch.
Your other video, audio and control settings are kept; turn the toggle off to set things yourself again.

sections.title: More performance mods
items: Added ten more one-click optimisations, including Noisium, Memory Leak Fix, Debugify, Starlight, Enhanced Block Entities, Pluto, VintageFix and Very Many Players.
Every recommended mod is still checked against the instance's Minecraft version and loader before it can be selected.
Fabric, Quilt, Forge and NeoForge instances all get their own compatible kit.

sections.title: Updates reach everyone
items: Launchers now fall back to the public update feed if a build is missing its bundled feed, so an update can no longer be silently skipped.
Triad also checks when you return to the window, after the PC wakes, and every 15 minutes while it is open.
Anyone still on a build from before update support needs one manual install of this version; every build from here on updates itself.

sections.title: Launcher updates
items: This build verifies the automatic update path from GitHub.
When a newer version is published, Triad shows an Update banner, downloads it, and offers Restart & update.
Accounts, instances, mods, worlds and settings stay in place.

sections.title: Under the hood
items: The installer includes the public update feed, so future versions can reach installed launchers.

releases.title: A brighter Triad, ready to update itself

sections.title: Automatic launcher updates
items: Triad now checks for a new build when it starts and downloads it in the background.
When the update is ready, restart Triad from the prompt or let it install when you close the launcher.
Accounts, instances, mods, worlds and settings stay in place.

sections.title: Every theme, everywhere
items: The selected theme now colours the background, sidebar, titlebar, glass panels and controls.
The Launcher colour picker recolours the whole shell, not just the buttons.
Frost keeps its primary buttons readable in the light theme.

sections.title: More skins
items: Added the solid Full Black and Full White skins.
Browse 628 skins with search, categories and your own PNG uploads.

sections.title: One-time patch notes
items: This screen appears after an update so you can see what changed.
It stays out of the way on later launches.
